outcome: infant weight gain (rate of return to birth weight)
cohort: The study included 135 women undergoing a cesarean section in a hospital in Bushehr, Iran.
finding: Both foot reflexology and Benson relaxation methods significantly decreased postoperative pain, increased breastfeeding frequency, and improved the rate of infant weight gain compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on women undergoing a cesarean section, finding that both interventions were effective in this group; however, it did not compare findings based on different modes of birth.
birth_weight: N/A (infant weight was assessed at birth and 10 days later, but no specific inclusion criteria for birth weight range were mentioned)
